name: Diazepam 10mg — 20 Tablets (Generic for Valium®)
short: Diazepam 10 mg, 20 tablets — benzodiazepine with anxiolytic, sedative, and muscle relaxant effects. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Diazepam is a benzodiazepine with anxiolytic, sedative, muscle-relaxant and anticonvulsant properties. The active ingredient is diazepam 10 mg per tablet, and this presentation contains 20 tablets manufactured under Mexican pharmaceutical regulations.

Diazepam is generally prescribed for short-term management of anxiety symptoms, as a muscle relaxant for spasticity, or as adjunctive therapy in certain seizure disorders. Long-term use is not typical due to the potential for tolerance and dependence. Always consult your healthcare provider for appropriate dosing and duration of therapy.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout Cabo San Lucas and the corridor. Prescription Required. A valid medical prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
